commits.message:
collapse glossary entries by default, merge 14 duplicate terms

- Terms render as compact clickable rows, expand on click to show
  full brief, context, and refs. Auto-expands when linked via hash.
- Merge duplicate entries sharing the same Greek lemma: χριστός
  (Messiah/Anointed), ἐγώ εἰμι (I am/I AM), ζωὴ αἰώνιος (4 variants),
  υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου (3 variants), priestly service (3 Greek words),
  δικαιοσύνη justice pair, κρίσις/δίκη pair, keep us in suspense,
  son of destruction, gracious forbearance, donkey-millstone.
- 378 -> 364 terms.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix glossary term matching after punctuation characters

Non-word characters (quotes, parens) caused the matcher to skip the
entire next word. Advance by one character instead so terms immediately
after punctuation are still detected.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

glossary redesign: category nav, search filter, dual Greek reference system

- Reorganize glossary page with sticky category nav bar, search/filter input,
  and alphabetical sorting within categories
- Add greekAppearsIn data showing where Greek lemma appears but English
  rendering differs (23k+ new cross-references via build_greek_refs.py)
- Update ExpandableRefs and WordModal to display both reference types
- Merge duplicate χριστός entries (Messiah + Anointed) into single entry
  with slash-separated alternative rendering support

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
